description: Runs neatly's free check on the user's actual damage bill. Send the bill (screenshot, photo or PDF) and/or the damage photos the host or rental company sent, as https links or base64. Six AI agents check the photos (AI-made or edited, reused, photos of a screen, photo dates) and every charge against the platform's rules and the country's law. Returns the verdict, the amount at stake, the every point found, how many more points the full report has, and a report link for the user. Free, no account. Ask the user before sending their files. If the bill turns out fair the full report unlocks free.

amount.description: Amount being asked for, if known

bill_type.description: stay for a holiday or vacation rental, car for a rental car or car hire. Worked out from platform if left out

checkout_or_return_date.description: Checkout date for a stay or return date for a car, YYYY-MM-DD, if known

country.description: AU for Australia, US for the United States. Defaults to the site that was called

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, e.g. USD or AUD. Defaults to the country's currency

description.description: The host's or company's message and anything the user says happened, in their words. Optional

files.description: At least one bill or one of their damage photos. Roles: bill = the bill or message (up to 3, PDF allowed), theirs = the damage photos they sent (up to 8), mine = the user's own photos from the end of the stay or rental (up to 6), listing = listing or pick-up photos (up to 4). Originals work best: forwarded or screenshotted photos lose their hidden details

data_base64.description: The file as base64, instead of a url. Keep all base64 files in one call under 4 MB in total; use https links for anything bigger

url.description: Public https link to the file

platform.description: Who sent the bill, e.g. Airbnb, Booking.com, Vrbo, Stayz, Hipcamp, Hertz, Sixt, Avis, Budget, Enterprise, Europcar, Turo, Zipcar, Outdoorsy, RVshare, Camplify, JUCY, Britz, Maui, a direct host

name: check_bill
title: Run the free bill check
